title: (No AI) YouTube is building AI creator tools that do almost everything for them
author: Mia Sato
content:
![YouTube creator tool offering AI features like summarizing comments and editing.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Creation-YT-Studio-Bundle-Optimize-your-Catalog-UX-Flow-2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Part of the job of a content creator is to figure out how to get their work in front of the most people. Cracking - or fighting - the algorithm has historically been a frustration for creators, but YouTube is increasingly simply telling creators what they should do.

At the annual creator-focused Made on YouTube event, the company announced updates to the suite of AI-powered creator tools it [unveiled in 2025](https://www.theverge.com/news/778469/youtube-creators-ai-analytics-ask-studio-dubbing). In its initial iteration, the dashboard of creator tools included things like A/B testing for video thumbnails and a chatbot interface to query how content was performing. This year's update adds AI tools for more complex tasks.

title: (No AI) OpenAI nabs key Patreon execs ahead of upcoming announcement
author: Jess Weatherbed
content:
![An illustration of Patreon’s logo.](https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2025/04/STK326_PATREON_A.jpg?quality=90&strip=all&crop=0,0,100,100)

Patreon cofounder Sam Yam is joining OpenAI to lead Creator Product. | Image: The Verge

OpenAI has hired three former Patreon execs to anchor its product strategy for creators. After starting the creator subscription platform 13 years ago, cofounder and technology chief [Sam Yam announced on X](https://x.com/samyamiam/status/2102503574492332141) that he's joining OpenAI to lead Creator Product. He's also bringing Patreon's former product head [Drew Rowny](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/drowny_last-week-i-wrapped-up-four-of-the-most-meaningful-share-7497665160883412993-vjZn/) and engineering head [Shannon Ma](https://lnkd.in/p/eM9EF_r4) with him on the new venture, both of whom stepped down in the past few weeks.
